{{Quote| Why Yago? Why not just kill them and be done with it?!''"<br />"''Because, Gallan, they are of better use as hostages than as corpses. The Republic won't sacrifice a Jedi like Plo Koon or a noted officer like Captain Dodonna!|Gallan and Mellor Yago|<ref name="SWR69" />}}
'''Gallan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer of the [[Rendili Home Defense Fleet]]. He served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and was stationed aboard the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Mersel Kebir]]'' and supported fellow Lieutenant [[Mellor Yago]]'s coup against [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jace Dallin]]. Gallan was executed by Yago during the [[Battle of Rendili]].

==Behind the scenes==
His name is also spelled Gallon in the comic.
